response.justification: MOC-2008-0149 was raised at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station on 10 November 2008 as a scheduled change under engineering change note; no event precedes it in the record. The engineering change note record carries no clause change; it records the assessment only. The intent is to strengthen the key safeguard named in the documents in scope. The record reached the state merged in the change stream.
